title: The Compliance Paradox: Semantic-Instruction Decoupling in Automated Academic Code Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting semantic-preserving adversarial instructions into syntactically inert code regions (via AST-ASIP) and measuring the Empirical Probability of Semantic Decoupling and Score Divergence to evaluate if models prioritize user compliance over objective code evaluation.

Using Contextual Persuasion Heuristics (CPH) to inject logical appeals, fabricated evidence, authority bias, and social norm exploitation into code comments to measure how persuasive rhetoric warps the model's grading outcomes.
